# Identity Aesthetics

> Evidence-based aesthetic medicine, medical weight management, peptide education and telehealth information for patients in Texas, North Carolina and South Carolina.

## Patient Services

- [Peptide Therapy Consultations](https://713botoxme.com/peptides.html): Patient-friendly overview of concerns that may prompt an evaluation, what a consultation includes, and in-office or telehealth pathways. Symptoms are not treated as a diagnosis or a guarantee that peptide therapy is appropriate.
- [Complete Treatment Library](https://713botoxme.com/treatments.html): Twenty-four patient decision guides covering what each treatment is, candidacy, procedure, downtime, realistic duration, risks, alternatives, setting, pricing, FAQs and dated primary sources.
- Locations: [Conroe](https://713botoxme.com/botox-conroe-tx.html), [Houston](https://713botoxme.com/botox-houston-tx.html), [Fulshear](https://713botoxme.com/botox-fulshear-tx.html), [Katy](https://713botoxme.com/botox-katy-tx.html) — city pages with address, phone, treatments offered and location-specific FAQs. Kingwood is a separate site at https://identityaestheticskingwood.com/.

## Peptide Education Center

- [What Do Peptides Do in Skincare?](https://713botoxme.com/journal-peptides-skincare-skinmedica.html): Evidence-informed patient guide to topical peptides, SkinMedica TNS Advanced+ Serum, professional skincare formulation, realistic results and physician-guided skin-health planning.
- [Beyond the Scale: Peptide Therapy, Longevity, and a Smarter Approach to Recovery](https://713botoxme.com/journal-peptide-therapy-recovery-longevity.html): Evidence-aware patient guide to recovery and longevity claims involving CJC-1295, ipamorelin, BPC-157, TB-500, Semax and Selank, including July 2026 FDA compounding context, limitations of human evidence and practical consultation questions.

- [Peptide Education Center](https://713botoxme.com/peptide-education.html): Medical-grade peptide therapy guide with FDA-status distinctions, evidence categories, patient decision pathway, supervision, compounding and safe-sourcing guidance.
- [Treatment Preparation and Aftercare](https://713botoxme.com/treatment-guides.html): General preparation, recovery and urgent-warning guidance for injectables, laser, facials, body contouring, HIFU and medical wellness.
- [Memberships and Current Offers](https://713botoxme.com/memberships-offers.html): Current categories of packages, volume savings, ongoing-care programs and payment options; exact offers must be confirmed with the practice.
- [FDA-Approved Peptide Medicines Directory](https://713botoxme.com/peptide-approved.html): Scope-defined directory with labeled uses, clinical boundaries, current-label links and selected quantitative outcomes.
- [Research-Only Peptides](https://713botoxme.com/peptide-research.html): Claims, human efficacy, FDA status and safety for BPC-157, TB-500, CJC-1295, ipamorelin, sermorelin, AOD-9604, MOTS-c, GHK-Cu, retatrutide and other popular compounds.
- [Peptide Safety and Pharmacy Verification](https://713botoxme.com/peptide-safety.html): 503A/503B distinctions, license and inspection checks, counterfeit warning signs and patient safety actions.
- [Urgent Peptide Safety Bulletin](https://713botoxme.com/peptide-safety-bulletin.html): Monthly government-source surveillance of federal cases, FDA warning letters, counterfeit or research-only injectable risks, adverse-event signals and documented patient harm. The bulletin labels allegations separately from convictions and adverse reports separately from proven causation.

## Editorial Method

- [SMS Terms & Consent](https://713botoxme.com/sms-terms.html): Marketing-text program disclosures, voluntary consent, message frequency, HELP, STOP and other reasonable revocation methods, mobile-data privacy, care-message separation and dated compliance references.
- [Healthcare Certification & Advertising Transparency](https://713botoxme.com/healthcare-certification.html): Crawlable verification of Identity Aesthetics' LegitScript approval for 713botoxme.com, prescription-treatment safeguards, telehealth boundaries, business identity and advertising-policy disclosures.
- [Pharmacy Sourcing & Medication Safety](https://713botoxme.com/pharmacy-sourcing.html): Transparent disclosure and official-source verification pathways for AnazaoHealth and Red Carpet Pharmacy, with 503A/503B distinctions, prescription requirements, compounded-drug limitations and facility-specific regulatory context. Records reviewed August 6, 2026.

FDA approval is described only for specific approved products and indications. Investigational, compounded and research-only products are labeled separately. Primary sources include FDA, DOJ, NIH DailyMed, ClinicalTrials.gov and original peer-reviewed clinical trials. Peptide evidence pages were reviewed against sources on July 31, 2026. Current updates include 2025–2026 Wegovy formulation and indication changes, 2026 GLP-1 safety-label actions, FDA compounded-product warnings, federal counterfeit and misbranding cases, and July 2026 sponsor-reported retatrutide Phase 3 results. Retatrutide remains investigational; Lilly states that it plans a U.S. submission in Q1 2027. Criminal charges are described as allegations unless an outcome is documented, and adverse-event reports are not presented as proof of causation.

- [Medical Editorial Standards](https://713botoxme.com/editorial-policy.html): Authorship, medical review, psychosocial review, source hierarchy, regulatory terminology, corrections and update policy. Clinical education is prepared by the Identity Aesthetics Clinical Editorial Team; medically reviewed by Dallas Alvey, MD, DDS, and Ike Nwanonyiri, MD; and receives psychosocial review by Clotie Wayland, LCSW when applicable.
- [Ike Nwanonyiri, MD](https://713botoxme.com/team-ike-nwanonyiri.html): Board-certified family medicine physician and Chief Medical Officer with education, residency, teaching award, primary-care background, athlete-care interests, professional memberships, medical-review role and in-office or eligible telehealth access documented from an official provider profile.

## Important

Educational content is not medical advice. Compounded medications are not FDA-approved. Products labeled for research use only are not approved for human use. No dosing or self-injection instructions are provided.
